sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the fundamental mechanism of a nutrient film technique (NFT) setup used in hydroponic farming systems. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: NFT involves a continuous, shallow stream of nutrient-infused water flowing through PVC pipes, allowing bare plant roots to absorb nutrients while getting adequate oxygen.

questions.question_text: Identify two primary areas in a school building where a water audit team should look to measure daily water wastage. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The team should inspect the washroom facilities for leaking faucets and running toilets, as well as the drinking water stations for continuous overflows.

questions.question_text: State the main purpose of providing proper ventilation and clean bedding in the housing of livestock farm animals. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Proper ventilation removes harmful ammonia gases, while clean bedding prevents bacterial infections, ensuring the overall health, comfort, and productivity of the farm animals.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are tasked with constructing a simple bamboo bookshelf. Outline the sequential safety and preparation steps you must take before cutting the bamboo stalks. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, wear protective safety goggles and thick work gloves to prevent splinter injuries. Next, securely clamp the bamboo stalk to a stable workbench. Finally, accurately measure and mark the exact cutting points using a pencil and a try square.
